provider-org.narrative: Special Fund for Policy and Human Resources Development

title.narrative: Grievances registered related to delivery of project benefits that are addressed
Pregnant women attending ANC supplemented with IFA
Pregnant women attending at least four ANC visits
Women between the ages of 15-49 years currently using a modern FP method
Births attended by skilled health personnel
Births registered within 6 months of occurrence
Children immunized with the third dose of Pentavalent
Reports submitted to DHIS in a timely manner.
A benefit package developed, costed, and disseminated
Implementing entities submitting the annual FM and technical report on time
RMNCAH related operations research completed to inform policy/strategy
People who have received essential health, nutrition, and population (HNP) services
Number of deliveries attended by skilled health personnel
Lessons learned from UHC Phase I documented and disseminated
Vulnerable and marginalized communities reached in their indigenous language
Designated laboratories with COVID diagnostic equipment
Reported suspected cases of COVID-19 cases investigated based on national guidelines
